On behalf of our client, a progressive and data-driven Angus seed stock operation in the Great Southern region, we are seeking a dedicated and skilled Beef Cattle Farm Worker. This is not just a farmhand role; it is an opportunity to contribute to a strategic breeding program focused on excellence.
Our client has meticulously built a renowned breeding herd over the past decade, with a core philosophy of combining superior genetics with functional, structurally sound cattle. They are committed to advancing their herd through rigorous data-driven selection and a steadfast focus on traits that deliver real profitability and reliability for their commercial bull customers.
We are looking for an individual who is passionate about modern, sustainable beef production and possesses a keen eye for animal detail. The successful candidate will play a hands-on role in the daily care and strategic management of this high-value stud herd, ensuring the highest standards of animal welfare, pasture health, and operational efficiency are maintained.

Key Responsibilities & Duties:
Livestock Care & Health Management
• Conduct daily inspections of cattle to monitor health, behaviour, and well-being, promptly reporting any signs of illness, injury, or distress.
• Feed and water management: Ensure cattle receive balanced nutrition by distributing feed, maintaining feeding schedules, and keeping water troughs clean and functional.
• Assist with veterinary procedures, including vaccinations, drenching, tagging, and administering medications under supervision.
• Support calving operations, assisting with birthing when necessary and ensuring newborn calves receive proper care.
• Assist in breeding programs, including heat detection, artificial insemination (if applicable), and record-keeping.

Grazing & Pasture Management
• Rotational grazing: Move cattle between paddocks to optimize pasture usage, prevent overgrazing, and promote forage regrowth.
• Monitor pasture conditions, identifying weed infestations, soil erosion, or fencing issues that may affect livestock movement.
• Assist in silage/hay production (if applicable), including cutting, baling, and storage for winter feed.

Farm Maintenance & Equipment Operation
• Perform routine repairs on fences, gates, cattle yards, and handling facilities to ensure structural integrity and livestock safety.
• Maintain and clean feeding systems, water pumps, and irrigation equipment to prevent blockages or malfunctions.
• Operate farm machinery (tractors, ATVs, feed mixers, etc.) for feeding, spraying, or pasture maintenance (training provided if needed).
• Assist with weed and pest control to maintain a safe and productive grazing environment.

Cattle Handling & Movement
• Safely mustering, drafting, and sorting cattle using low-stress handling techniques.
• Assist with loading/unloading livestock for transport, sales, or processing, ensuring compliance with animal welfare standards.
• Participate in branding, tagging, and weighing operations as part of herd management.

Record-Keeping & Compliance
• Maintain accurate livestock records, including health treatments, breeding, and weight data.
• Follow biosecurity protocols to prevent disease spread between livestock or properties.
• Adhere to workplace health and safety regulations, including safe chemical handling and machinery use.

Requirements & Qualifications:
• Minimum 1 year of experience in beef cattle farming, livestock handling, or a related agricultural role.
• Strong animal husbandry skills with an understanding of cattle behaviour, nutrition, and health needs.
• Farm machinery experience (tractors, quad bikes, feed wagons) is highly desirable.
• Basic mechanical skills for minor repairs and maintenance of farm infrastructure.
• Valid driver’s license (truck or tractor license is a plus).
• Flexibility to work early mornings, weekends, and public holidays as required by seasonal demands.
• Team player with strong communication skills and the ability to follow instructions.
• Certification in Livestock Production, Agriculture, or Animal Science if preferable but not required.

How to Apply:
Interested candidates should submit a resume and brief cover letter outlining their experience and suitability for the role.

Senior Digital Business Analyst




Care, reimagined


Design and deliver innovative learning that builds clinical digital capability


Permanent, full time role, hybrid workplace model




Shape the Digital Future of Healthcare Across Victoria.




Great digital systems only deliver when they are designed around the real-world needs of the people using them. This newly created role is about bridging the gap between clinical reality and digital innovation-translating complex organizational and frontline needs into practical, high-impact digital solutions that move Monash Health toward genuine service transformation.





Make a Difference Through Digital Health


About The Role



We are now seeking an experienced and passionate Senior Digital Business Analyst to join our Innovation, Platforms and Partnership team within the Digital and Information Division.



This is an opportunity to work on some of Victoria's most significant digital health initiatives, helping transform the way care is delivered across clinical and non-clinical services. You will work alongside project managers, clinicians, technical specialists, operational leaders and executives to design solutions that improve patient care, streamline services and deliver meaningful outcomes for our community.



We are looking for someone who values teamwork, thrives on solving complex problems, and wants to contribute to projects that have a genuine impact on the lives of patients, families and healthcare staff.



You will lead business analysis activities from project initiation through to solution implementation, working closely with stakeholders to understand business needs, identify opportunities for improvement and help deliver practical, sustainable solutions.



You will also:





Lead stakeholder engagement, workshops and requirements gathering activities across clinical and corporate services.


Develop business cases, project initiation documentation and solution proposals that support organisational priorities


Analyse business processes, workflows and service models to identify improvement opportunities and deliver measurable benefits


Work closely with technical teams to translate business requirements into effective digital solutions.


Support solution design, testing, implementation and change activities across complex projects.


Contribute to portfolio planning, resource management and prioritisation activities across a diverse digital project portfolio.






What We're Looking For



We are seeking a collaborative and community-minded professional who enjoys working with others to achieve shared outcomes.



You will bring:





Extensive experience as a Senior Business Analyst within large and complex environments.


Strong stakeholder engagement, facilitation and communication skills with the ability to build trusted relationships at all levels of an organisation.


Experience preparing business cases, analysing business processes and developing solution recommendations.


Demonstrated ability to lead workshops, manage competing priorities and influence outcomes in complex environments.


Experience working across both Agile and Waterfall delivery environments.


A proactive, solutions-focused approach and a commitment to delivering outcomes that improve services for our patients and community.





Experience in healthcare or digital health is highly regarded.






Why join Monash Health?



This is more than a digital role-it's your chance to transform healthcare at scale. Working at the intersection of clinical care, technology and innovation, you'll help create smarter digital solutions that improve patient outcomes and support the clinicians who deliver them every day




At Monash Health, you will:






Lead a state-wide service with real impact


Work within a values-driven, purpose-led organisation


Be part of a connected network of clinical, academic and system leaders


Help drive innovation, inclusion and better health outcomes








We also offer:






The opportunity to make a real impact on patient experience


A supportive, collaborative team environment


Ongoing learning and development opportunities


The chance to be part of Victoria's largest public health service
